# TuneGuide AI — Specialization Before/After Comparison

Verified results comparing the baseline pipeline (no interpreter) with the specialized pipeline (deterministic natural-language preference interpreter). Both use the integrated `RecommendationAgent`. The baseline receives only a natural-language request with no structured profile, so it cannot build a profile and fails validation.

*Generated by `python -m experiments.run_specialization_comparison`.*

## Summary

| Request | Baseline | Specialized profile | Confidence | Candidates (base → spec) | Reliability | Improved retrieval |
|---------|----------|---------------------|------------|--------------------------|-------------|--------------------|
| I'm studying for my robotics exam. | validation failed | favorite_genre=lofi, favorite_mood=focused, target_energy=0.3, likes_acoustic=True | High | 0 → 3 | 86 | Yes |
| I'm lifting weights. | validation failed | favorite_genre=electronic, favorite_mood=intense, target_energy=0.9, likes_acoustic=False | High | 0 → 1 | 93 | Yes |
| I'm driving home after work. | validation failed | favorite_genre=pop, favorite_mood=uplifting, target_energy=0.6, likes_acoustic=False | High | 0 → 1 | 87 | Yes |
| I'm coding late at night. | validation failed | favorite_genre=lofi, favorite_mood=focused, target_energy=0.4, likes_acoustic=False | High | 0 → 3 | 86 | Yes |
| I need relaxing music while reading. | validation failed | favorite_genre=ambient, favorite_mood=relaxed, target_energy=0.3, likes_acoustic=True | High | 0 → 1 | 93 | Yes |
| Help me fall asleep. | validation failed | favorite_genre=ambient, favorite_mood=relaxed, target_energy=0.15, likes_acoustic=True | High | 0 → 1 | 93 | Yes |
| I want something nostalgic. | validation failed | favorite_genre=indie pop, favorite_mood=nostalgic, target_energy=0.5, likes_acoustic=False | Medium | 0 → 1 | 87 | Yes |
| I'm feeling energetic. | validation failed | favorite_genre=electronic, favorite_mood=euphoric, target_energy=0.85, likes_acoustic=False | Medium | 0 → 1 | 100 | Yes |

## Case Details

### I'm studying for my robotics exam.

| Field | Baseline | Specialized |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| success | False | True |
| inferred confidence | — | High |
| profile | {'favorite_genre': None, 'favorite_mood': None, 'target_energy': None, 'likes_acoustic': None} | {'favorite_genre': 'lofi', 'favorite_mood': 'focused', 'target_energy': 0.3, 'likes_acoustic': True} |
| retrieved candidates | 0 | 3 |
| recommendations | 0 | 3 |
| reliability score | — | 86 |

**Improved retrieval:** Yes — specialization enabled a request the baseline could not interpret.
